adapter.terms: GDELT Project open data (free; cite GDELT). GDELT asks for at most one request every 5 seconds.

get_news.note: GDELT DOC 2.0 ArtList (JSON), newest first. query uses GDELT syntax (keywords, "phrases", OR, domain:, sourcelang:, theme: …) and is required by GDELT; since (ISO date/datetime) becomes startdatetime and must be within the last 3 months; maxrecords ≤ 250 (capped at 100). There is no paging — ignore next_page. published_at is GDELT's seendate (YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ); language and sourcecountry are in raw. When called more than once per 5 s GDELT answers a plain-text notice instead of JSON (articles is then empty). The ~40 RSS/Atom feeds, Tree of Alpha, Binance announcements and Fear & Greed collected by this entry's source are not mapped.

not_offered.get_candles: News source; GDELT has no price data.
not_offered.get_series: alternative.me Fear & Greed (https://alternative.me/crypto/fear-and-greed-index/#api) answers value as a JSON string ('71'), which the numeric `value` field cannot carry without a numeric-coercion expression in result mapping; GDELT timelines are a different mode not mapped here.

live_check.notes: upstream: GDELT DOC 2.0 answers 429 'Please limit requests to one every 5 seconds' after ~11 s even to single isolated requests, from a datacenter and a residential connection (worked once earlier the same day); not fixable client-side; get_news failed: rate_limited 429 rate limited by the platform
